name: home
description: Represents home, dashboard, or primary landing navigation. On hover the roofline unwrites and retraces itself while the house stands still.

animation.description: The roofline unwrites and retraces itself (pathLength 1-0-1, 0.35s draw ease) while walls, floor, and door stay fixed — the shelter reaffirmed by a single stroke. Ends at rest. Reduced motion: static.

accessibility.notes: Main navigation entry point. Ensure aria-label or visible label text indicates current page state when active.
